learning_units.description: Circular movement to the right and center step progression.

social_formats.description: Women's circular group dance with improvisational movement.

movement_profile.footwork: Improvised steps moving to the right of the circle and stepping toward the center
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular formation moving to the right and inward toward the center

signature_moves.description: Lateral progression around the circle towards the right.
signature_moves.name: Rightward circle progression

signature_moves.description: Improvised step sequence moving towards the center of the circle.
signature_moves.name: Center step

music_profile.sound_description: A traditional Cappadocian Greek vocal song accompaniment focusing on lyrical stanzas about Sinasos women, romance, and festive joy.
music_profile.vocal_style: Traditional singing in Greek with repeating verse-refrain structure detailing love and local pride

basic_steps: Form a circle with participating female dancers.
Step progressively to the right along the circular perimeter.
Step inward towards the center of the circle as improvised by the dancers.
teaching.level_notes: Improvisational circle dance moving right and inward toward the center.
